skills.name: backend-environment
skills.description: Stand up or locate the runnable backend target and enforce hygiene: env vars present, ports free, clean test DB/state, kill stale processes. Triggers: 'start the service', 'reset the test DB'.

skills.name: backend-reproduce
skills.description: Backend reproduce recipes: Logic = a failing test written first; System = reproduce in the failing env and instrument the boundaries. UI refused. Internal: engine reproduce step.

skills.name: backend-verify
skills.description: Backend verify recipes mirroring reproduce: Logic = failing test passes + suite green; System = boundary logs correct + pipeline green. Never closes on a diff. Internal: engine verify step.

skills.name: backend-source-map
skills.description: Symptom -> file hints on common backend stacks: route/handler -> service/use-case -> data layer. Generic only; org specifics belong to packs. Internal: engine isolate step on a backend bug.
